description: Utility module providing helper functions and classes for constructing, processing, and managing responses API interactions within the litellm project. Includes functions for validating parameters, encoding/decoding response IDs, transforming response format specifications, extracting headers, and logging utilities.

classes.name: ResponsesAPIRequestUtils
classes.description: A collection of static utility methods for handling responses API request construction, ID encoding/decoding, parameter validation, and response text conversion.

classes.name: ResponseAPILoggingUtils
classes.description: A collection of static utility methods for logging and interpreting responses API usage data.
